newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Republic A off 21.88 pct on correction.
newsitem.headline: Republic A off 21.88 pct on correction.

text.p: Oil firm Republic Resources and Development Corp (Redeco) Class A shares dropped 2.1 pesos, or 21.88 percent to 7.50 pesos in late trade on Wednesday due to a technical correction, traders said.

"After a jump of close to 2,000 percent when the suspension on the stock was lifted on Monday, this could only be a technical correction," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor Hagedorn Securities.
The Philippine Stock Exchange lifted its two-and-a-half year trading suspension on Redeco on Monday after the company complied with the bourse's disclosure requirements.
The shares of Redeco, a holding company, then soared to a day high of 22 pesos but ended at 10.50 pesos.
"Aside from correction, there was also some short-selling on the issue," said Bogart Cruz, trading manager at Asia Pacific Capital Equities Inc.
Redeco was one of the top 10 most heavily-traded issues in Wednesday's session with turnover valued at 94.64 million pesos.
